'''Tough Seven''' was the callsign of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Tough Squadron]] who fought at the [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Dantooine]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. During the battle, the pilot flew a type of [[Ugly/Legends|ugly]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] known as an [[X-ceptor]] and was covered by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilot [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] as it commenced an attack run against the advancing [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces.
